set: A: the keys `step2-rest` and `step2-dial`, whole and in native crops, and the sheet `machines`, each beside the approved image

issues.what: the build's row shows five dials starting with a steel "1" left of the orange 2; the approved row begins at the orange 2 with bare wall to its left, so -b's row runs one dial longer and further left
issues.fix: drop the leading steel dial and start the row at the orange 2, keeping the right end where it is

issues.where: the button crop (also set-A-01-b and set-A-03-b, lower right)
issues.what: the Continue button is a dull dark-grey pill with dark grey lettering; in the approved it is a light silvery pill with pale, near-white lettering and a brighter sheen
issues.fix: lighten the button face toward silver-grey and make its label light

issues.where: the round-button and bare-surface crops (also the header row in every full view)
issues.what: the metal dials read as dull gunmetal with long, hard, dark shadows; the approved dials are bright polished chrome sitting in tight, short, soft shadows
issues.fix: brighten the steel, restore the strong specular small-side highlight upper-left, and shorten and soften the drop shadows

issues.where: all type, headline to footnote (repeated in every pair)
issues.what: every line of type in -b renders near-black and a touch heavier; the approved type is a warm medium dark-grey
issues.fix: lighten all type toward the approved warm dark-grey and take a little weight off

issues.where: the dial and the tray-the-machine-sits-in crops (also set-A-03-b)
issues.what: the open machine's tray interior is a darker grey-green with a heavy dark inner edge, and the rotary dial face is dull steel with a flat, dark orange centre; the approved tray is light silvery and the dial is polished steel with a glossy bright-orange centre button
issues.fix: lighten the tray interior toward silver, polish the dial face, and restore the centre button's gloss

issues.where: dial centre knob, crank handle grip, lit volume bars (also the orange step-2 button in every pair)
issues.what: the orange parts are matte and darker, with no bright highlight and no warm glow on the surrounding surface; the approved knobs and grips are glossy with a crisp highlight and throw a soft orange reflection onto the page
issues.fix: restore the gloss highlight upper-left on every orange part and the soft orange spill under them

issues.what: -b's page is cooler and dimmer, a grey-ivory; the approved page is a brighter warm cream, so the build's mood is colder
issues.fix: warm the page tone and lift overall brightness slightly

issues.what: the build shows a horizontal slot/handle bar beneath the drum that the approved machine does not have
issues.fix: remove the slot bar under the drum

issues.what: the build shows a line of grey body text there; the approved view has no line at that place, leaving bare page between the step title and the machine labels
issues.fix: if the line stays (per copy), expect it; otherwise the layout gap reads differently from the approved

issues.what: the cursor carries a hard, dark offset shadow; the approved arrow has a soft, pale, close bloom of shade under it
issues.fix: soften and lighten the arrow's shadow, pull it in tight

issues.where: the hairline rule under the title (all pairs)
issues.what: the rule under the header is darker and throws a visible shadow; the approved rule is a quiet light line
issues.fix: lighten the rule and take its shadow away
